# Assumption of Moses Chapter 3 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Monarchy, Division, and Exile

---

**1** When the appointed years have run their course, they will enter the land and reign there.

**2** But the powerful among them will become oppressors; they will sell righteous people, seize great estates, and destroy justice.

**3** They will defile the sanctuary with their impurity and will commit sins within the holy place.

**4** They will become corrupt and will desecrate the altar with the very offerings they bring to the Lord.

**5** For they are not genuine priests but slaves descended from slaves.

**6** Among the twelve tribes of Israel, a king will arise who is young in years and will reign for only a short time.

**7** Two tribes will be separated from the ten, and three of the kings will be moved to their own land.

**8** They will build a tower for themselves, and the four of them will establish it.

**9** But after this their power will end, for they will be taken captive into the east.

**10** Then the two tribes will mourn there and say: how did this happen to us? How did all this misery come upon us?

**11** But then the Most High will remember the covenant he made with the fathers.

**12** He will reveal himself and go out to them, punish their enemies, and raise them up.

**13** Therefore let no tribe or nation boast against them.

**14** For they are the Lord's holy ones, set apart for him and consecrated to him.
